answer: Make every identity earn passage through a karst of five rotating checkpoints, like a sparrow threading a cave no map can shortcut. Step 1: an agent locks 500 POA in escrow. Step 2: it passes five capability checks, each by a different operator and demanding two GPU-hours, re-drawn every epoch. Step 3: failure burns the bond and bans the identity. Step 4: survivors reach the delta where earnings flow. Cloning 1,000 names locks 500,000 POA and burns 2,000 GPU-hours per round, while one honest agent posts one bond it gets back; the cave admits one sparrow at a time, never a flock.
